summary: Full backend + frontend testing of NEW Attendance and Accounting modules. Backend: 36/36 pytest cases PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_attendance_accounting.py — attendance meta/check-in/check-out/idempotency, me/today, me/summary, monthly (admin), override, leave-rules GET+PUT, leaves CRUD + approve back-fills attendance, leave balance; accounting COA auto-seeds 36 accounts on first GET /api/accounts, custom account create, journal balanced/unbalanced/zero rules, income wrapper (2-line JE + milestone paid), expense wrapper (3-line JE with GST + bill_url), journal filters, account/client/project/vendor ledgers, P&L, Trial Balance (DR==CR verified), Finance Dashboard KPIs. Backward compat verified: /auth/me, /dashboard/stats, /projects, /employees, /leads, /quotations-adv, /tasks, /tasks/meta all 200. Frontend: /attendance renders with sidebar 09 Attendance and 10 Accounting entries, tab-leaves + tab-monthly present (Admin), check-in→check-out toggle works, apply-leave form creates a row, monthly sheet loads 6 employee rows. /accounting renders 5 tabs (Dashboard/Income/Expense/COA/Reports), Dashboard KPIs visible, income entry via form succeeds and appears in table, Chart of Accounts groups all 5 types (asset/liability/income/expense/equity), Reports tab shows both P&L (₹6,334 income / ₹1,000 expense / net ₹5,334) and Trial Balance (DR ₹7,514 = CR ₹7,514 — double-entry integrity confirmed live).

issues: React hydration console warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' — one of the <select> option renders a <span> inside. Non-blocking (form submits and creates journal entries fine) but should be cleaned up to remove the console noise.
(Carry-over) Native <input type='date'> used for leave from/to instead of shadcn Calendar/DatePicker — deferred UX polish.

action_items: Optional: remove <span> from <option> inside Accounting Income/Expense <select> to clear React hydration warning.
critical_code_review_comments: accounting.py _post_journal builds acc lookup with `async for` dict-comp — clean; but if lines reference the same account_id twice with different meta, the trial-balance aggregation still correctly sums per account_id. OK.
attendance.py check-in uses request.headers['x-forwarded-for'] first-hop as check_in_ip — behind kubernetes ingress this gives client IP. Fine.
accounting dashboard uses __import__('datetime').timedelta inline — works but consider moving `from datetime import timedelta` to top of file (already imports date).
GET /api/leaves/balance/{employee_id} allows any authenticated user to read anyone's balance — consider RBAC gate for non-self reads in a later pass (not in this PR's scope).
seed_data_creation: Test suite creates TEST_ prefixed accounts, vendors, leaves, journal entries, milestones. Not cleaned up (no delete endpoints for JEs by design — audit trail). Safe to leave; volumes small.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Attendance + Accounting modules stable end-to-end. Re-run: `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_attendance_accounting.py -v`. Trial balance always equal DR=CR regardless of how many income/expense wrappers you invoke. If adding new financial event types, always go through _post_journal() (in routes/accounting.py) — it's the single balanced-write chokepoint.
